forPatients.subtitle: Twoja podróż zdrowotna zaczyna się tutaj
forPatients.giris: With Medagama you can find specialist doctors and clinics on one platform, book an online appointment, schedule a telehealth consultation and decide with confidence by reading verified patient reviews. Whether you are local or travelling for treatment, reaching the right health professional becomes easier.
forPatients.bulMetin: Search by specialty, city and expertise to list the doctors and clinics that fit your needs. Every profile shows specialties, services and patient reviews, so you can compare and choose what suits you best. Start a
forPatients.onlineRandevuMetin: Pick a suitable time slot and book an in-person appointment with your doctor. The process is transparent and takes only a few steps.
forPatients.telehealthMetin: Connect from wherever you are and schedule a consultation with doctors who offer remote appointments.
forPatients.yorumMetin: You can read other patients’ experiences before deciding. Verified patient reviews help you assess doctors and clinics better. If you would like a second opinion from another specialist, you can reach several professionals through the platform.

forPatients.madde2: Transparent profiles and verified patient reviews

forClinics.subtitle: Rozwijaj swoją praktykę z Medagama
forClinics.giris: For clinics, hospitals and independent doctors, Medagama is the way to reach a wider patient audience, manage appointments from one place and increase digital visibility. Create your profile, present your services and grow your patient reach.
forClinics.profilMetin: Build a profile with your specialties, the services you offer and your contact details, and be found by patients searching by specialty and city. Transparent, complete profiles help patients decide with confidence and make you stand out.
forClinics.randevuMetin: Track incoming appointment requests from a single panel, organise your calendar and keep communication with your patients simple.
forClinics.crmMetin: Manage your patient relationships, follow interactions and run your communication from one central place.
forClinics.erisimMetin: Medagama is multilingual, so you reach not only local patients but also international visitors researching Türkiye for medical tourism. Verified patient reviews build trust and help you receive more appointment requests.
